title: Making a Fall Guys mini game using IndieBuff AI
author: addit02

comments.author: addit02
comments.body:
Hey guys, I'm building IndieBuff, which is the tool you see in this vid. I want to make game dev more accessible and less tedious overall so hopefully this helps!

I'd love to get your guys' feedback, so if you wanna try it out free, join my Discord :)

[https://discord.com/invite/g3yccvZF7t](https://discord.com/invite/g3yccvZF7t)

replies.author: surpurdurd
replies.body: This looks like the kind of tool I've been waiting for! Does it run local, or with an API key of some sort? What kind of context limits do you run into?

replies.author: addit02
replies.body:
Right now it doesn’t run local, nor with your own api key, just goes through our server for convenience but we don’t store anything, all chats and history is stored locally. When we release publicly, we’ll have options to use your own api keys!

Context is tricky cause game objects can be massive so that’s why dragging in selected context is king right now until we optimize further.

It’s capable of building simple UIs atm but you’d be surprised how far we’ve been able to push it. Very basic still, but impressive regardless.
